wire.headline: Northbridge Steel to Close Deeside Plant in Major Restructuring
sentences: Northbridge Steel has announced that it will cut 4,800 jobs across its operations.
The company stated that this decision includes the closure of its Deeside blast furnace facility.
CEO Marian Holt cited a 12% price drop as a primary reason for the drastic measures.
The board of directors approved the restructuring plan by a vote of 7-2 on 4 November.
The estimated cost for severance packages amounts to 310m GBP.
The firm indicated that its remaining operations will shift to electric arc technology.
Shares in the company fell 15% following the release of the news.
